Hi Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the clean copy. Legal has one final ask before we start the DocuSign envelope: can you provide a signer attestation (names, titles, and the authority mechanism) for the people who will execute on Redwood's side? Acme needs an explicit attestation for our records (internal audit).

Also, we need a short chain-of-custody plan for the executed documents (who will receive the completed PDFs and on what timeline). Our procurement/compliance team requires that for vendor onboarding.

Jordan —

Appreciate the heads-up. Please find the signer-attestation-form attached (PDF) plus a short execution-chain-of-custody CSV that enumerates who receives each executed artifact. High-level plan below:

- DocuSign envelope: sequential routing (Acme signs first -> Redwood signers next). We prefer sequential to avoid partial-executed copies getting circulated.
- Primary Redwood signer: Karthik Iyer (SVP, Product) — he has board-delegated authority for standard SaaS MSAs and order forms up to our defined threshold.
- Secondary signer (if Karthik is unavailable): Priyom Das (Head of Revenue Ops) — authorized to countersign for renewals and SOWs.
- Post-signing delivery: executed PDFs go to Acme procurement (triley@acme.com), Acme legal (pshenoy@acmelegal.com), and Redwood Legal (legal@redwood.com). Clean copy uploaded to our contract repository (link included).

Notes / asks for Acme: please confirm the exact sign order you want on your side (Procurement -> Legal -> Exec). If you prefer parallel signing for Acme, let us know and we'll adjust the envelope.

Attaching: signer-attestation-form.pdf, execution-chain-of-custody.csv, redwood_msa_clean_v3.pdf, orderform_final.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole

Quick internal confirmation and a couple of operational items:

- Authority: Karthik does have delegated authority for this MSA + order form amount (see attached excerpt from delegation matrix). I'll also sign the attestation form so Acme has a witness record.
- EU witness: not needed — all Redwood signers for this deal are US-based. If Acme plans to have an EU exec sign on their side who requires witnessing, flag it now.
- DocuSign settings we will use: sequential routing, reminder every 48 hours, 30-day auto-cancel (we can shorten on request). Envelope message will include the attestation PDF inline so signers can confirm before signing.
- Final clean copies: Redwood Legal will stamp and store a time-stamped clean PDF and push to the S3 contract repository; I will export the execution log (CSV) and include it as an attachment to the HubSpot deal record.

Will upload the completed attestation and execution_log to the deal after signature. Karthik — if you want to be on the envelope as primary, say the word and I’ll initiate.
